extra.reason: LambdaWebMigration.rst now records the no-VM, two-Lambda architecture, current-checkout artifact deployment, one-host routing, external DynamoDB/S3 ownership, Lambda-served static assets, and the strict Sphinx docs build passed.

Added the lambda-web apig-wsgi adapter. Handler tests now exercise /ping, /ver, /about, /list, /api/check-api_key, and /static/planttracer.js through API Gateway v2-style events without rewriting Flask routes.

Added a lambda-web dependency group, requirements export, vendoring target, and Makefile checks. The exported requirements boundary keeps vision/video dependencies out of lambda-web; the same grep only finds imageio/opencv in lambda-resize.

template.yaml is now Lambda-only: VM resources and branch-clone parameters are removed, SAM/cfn-lint validation passes, and the template names separate lambda-web/lambda-resize functions, roles, logs, routes, and outputs.
Static assets stay packaged with and served by lambda-web through Flask. Tests and sam-status cover /static/planttracer.js, and no S3/CloudFront static origin was added.

The docs and SAM template use one HTTP API/custom domain with path routing: root/proxy traffic goes to lambda-web, /resize-api/* goes to lambda-resize, and /api/v1/movie-data remains an explicit lambda-resize compatibility route.

Makefile now builds/export-vendors both Lambda artifacts from the current checkout, removes VM/keypair/branch deploy prompts from the SAM path, and adds lambda-web/lambda-resize/static smoke and log helpers.

Added behavior-focused lambda-web tests for health/version/public/authenticated/API/static routes through the Lambda handler, using the existing local DynamoDB/MinIO fixtures where state is required. make pytest passes.

AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md now document the Beads Git/Dolt workflow, lambda-only migration constraints, same-host routing, static-hosting deferral, local Flask testing as primary, and Lambda/SAM checks as additive.

Package-boundary and readiness checks passed: dependency grep keeps vision/video deps out of lambda-web, local validation gates pass, SAM/cfn-lint passes, and make sam-build reports LambdaResizeFunction 219MB and LambdaWebFunction 64MB unzipped, both under the 250MB Lambda limit. Route smoke remains tracked under cutover validation.
